AI semiconductor revenue grew 221% YoY to $16.7B — confirmed upside to revenue and earnings. Multi-year guidance (FY2027 AI revenue $115B, FY2028 $230B) is forward-looking and potential, but the quarterly beat itself is confirmed.

headlines.headline: UBS Downgrades SAP to Neutral, Citing Only 17 of 200 AI Agents Delivered; Stock Falls ~4%
headlines.source: CNBC (live blog) / Yahoo Finance / BigGo Finance
headlines.summary: Potential downside: UBS downgraded SAP from Buy to Neutral on Aug 26, citing the company's slow AI agent rollout — only 17 out-of-the-box agents delivered against a year-end target of 200. Analysts flagged that this lag constrains near-term AI monetization and risks driving enterprise customers to build DIY AI tools. Cloud gross margins also fell for the first time since 2021. No confirmed revenue miss was reported; the downgrade reflects a potential (not confirmed) deceleration in SAP's AI revenue trajectory. SAP shares fell ~4% on the day.

headlines.headline: Marvell Grants Google $12.2B Stock Warrant in Custom AI Chip Deal Worth Up to $120B Through FY2033
headlines.summary: Potential upside: Marvell disclosed an expanded commercial agreement with Google (announced Aug 19; analysis and market reaction continued through Aug 22+). Google received a warrant to purchase up to 58.97 million Marvell shares at $206.58 each, vesting in tranches tied to every $500M of custom chip revenue through FY2033. The deal could bring Marvell up to ~$120B in cumulative revenue if all spending milestones are met — but this is conditional and milestone-based, not confirmed revenue. Broadcom (AVGO) fell >5% on the news as a competitive threat emerged. Scored +1 (potential) for MRVL and -1 for AVGO (competitive threat); composite score set to +1 reflecting the net new opportunity signal.

headlines.headline: Marvell Posts Record Q2 Revenue of $2.74B (+37% YoY), Raises FY2027 and FY2028 Outlook; Stock Falls ~8–10%
headlines.summary: Confirmed earnings beat: Marvell reported record Q2 FY2027 revenue of $2.739B (+37% YoY), beating guidance midpoint by $39M. Non-GAAP EPS of $0.94 beat the $0.87 consensus. Management raised FY2027 revenue outlook to ~$12B (~45% growth) and FY2028 outlook to ~$18B (~50% growth). Data center revenue grew 46% YoY and represents 79% of total revenue. The stock's post-earnings decline of ~8–10% reflects valuation/sentiment dynamics, not a deterioration in confirmed fundamentals; the revenue and guidance outcomes are unambiguously positive.

headlines.headline: AWS and Nvidia Announce 2 Million Additional GPU Deployment Deal for 2027–2028

This is a confirmed forward purchase agreement with direct and substantial revenue impact for Nvidia and a confirmed capex commitment for Amazon.

headlines.headline: Nvidia Q2 FY2027 Revenue Surges 106% to $96.2B; CEO Forecasts ~70% Fiscal 2028 Growth
headlines.summary: Confirmed earnings beat: Nvidia reported $96.2B in Q2 FY2027 revenue (+106% YoY), surpassing consensus of ~$92.2B, with data center revenue of $89B (+117% YoY). Q3 guidance of $108B also exceeded analyst expectations of $104.2B. Fiscal 2028 revenue growth guided at ~70% YoY. All impacts are confirmed, not potential.
